description: FireLaunch is a specialized launch board designed to move beyond the typical one-day spike of traditional product launches. It provides a platform where products earn their place through real engagement and a transparent scoring system known as Spark. Every listing undergoes a human review process and receives a dofollow backlink to support long-term SEO efforts.
